header: What the search line needs to know about this topic (pure, no React): the words of the Durgapur weather card ("durgapur weather report with forecast"). The data, its source and its checks are in src/lib/live/weather.ts; how it looks is in WeatherCard.tsx and ui.tsx. I list it once, in src/tools/registry.ts. Only Durgapur is known: a line that names another place ("weather in delhi") is not this card's, because I require every word of a line to be one of the key words, the extra words below or a filler.
